adds.text: Darcy interrupts Jane's date to bring her to the London factory where strange readings have appeared, and later stands with her at Greenwich using Selvig's devices against the Dark Elves.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jane, pulled from a date by Darcy to chase strange readings.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who pulls Jane from a date to chase strange readings.
adds.evidence: Darcy interrupts Jane's date with Richard about signals and drives her to the abandoned factory; the scientists use Selvig's devices at Greenwich.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Selvig reunites with Jane in London and works out that the Convergence will peak at Greenwich. There his last device sends Malekith's falling ship away from her and Thor.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Protégée Selvig saves from Malekith's falling ship at Greenwich.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Mentor whose last device saves Jane from Malekith's falling ship.
adds.evidence: Thor and Foster reunite in London with Foster's mentor Selvig, who locates the Convergence at Greenwich; Selvig teleports the Ark away as it nearly crushes Thor and Foster.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Selvig greets Thor in London and helps him find where Malekith will strike. At Greenwich, Selvig's devices let Thor stop Malekith, and his last one saves Thor from the falling Dark Elf ship.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who uses Selvig's devices to stop Malekith.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist whose device saves Thor from Malekith's falling ship.
adds.evidence: Selvig greets Thor at the apartment and identifies Greenwich; Thor uses Selvig's Gravimetric Spikes on Malekith; Selvig's device teleports the Ark away from the unconscious Thor.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Heimdall loses sight of Jane and sends Thor to find her. When Odin will not act, Heimdall agrees to help Thor take Jane off Asgard and confesses his treason to Odin to buy them time.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Friend Heimdall commits treason to help.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who commits treason to help Thor get Jane off Asgard.
adds.evidence: Heimdall tells Thor he has lost sight of Jane; in the tavern he reluctantly agrees to Thor's plan and then distracts Odin by confessing treason.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Sif helps free Loki for Thor's escape but holds her sword to his throat and warns that she will kill him if he betrays Thor. Loki only smiles and tells her it is nice to see her too.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Warrior who holds a sword to Loki's throat as a warning.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Prisoner Sif warns she will kill if he betrays Thor.
adds.evidence: Quote: 'Betray him, and I will kill you.' / 'Nice to see you, too, Sif.' Sif holds her sword to Loki's throat during the escape.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Volstagg and Fandral help Thor break Loki out of Asgard though they expect him to betray them. Volstagg threatens to kill him if he does, and Fandral mocks his clumsy fall into their skiff.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Thor's friends, who help free Loki but threaten and mock him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Prisoner the Warriors Three help free, but threaten if he betrays Thor.
adds.evidence: Volstagg: 'If you even think about betraying him...' Loki: 'You'll kill me? Evidently, there will be a line.' Fandral: 'I see your time in the dungeon has made you no less graceful, Loki.'
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Sif fights beside Volstagg, Fandral and Hogun against the Marauders on Vanaheim, then joins Volstagg and Fandral in defying Odin to help Thor escape Asgard.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow warriors Sif fights beside on Vanaheim.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow warrior who fights beside them on Vanaheim.
adds.evidence: Sif fights alongside the Warriors Three on Vanaheim; Sif, Fandral and Volstagg help Thor, Jane and Loki escape Asgard.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Sif saves Thor from a missile on Vanaheim and quietly hopes to rekindle his feelings for her. Later she frees Jane from her cell so Thor can take her off Asgard.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Old friend whose life Sif saves on Vanaheim.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Old friend who saves Thor's life and frees Jane for him.
adds.evidence: Sif blocks a missile aimed at Thor with her shield on Vanaheim; asks him to drink with her at the celebration; frees Jane from the guards for Thor's plan.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: The Warriors Three fight beside Thor on Vanaheim. Volstagg and Fandral then risk treason to help him smuggle Jane and Loki off Asgard, holding off the guards so he can escape.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Friend they risk treason to help escape Asgard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friends who risk treason to help Thor escape Asgard.
adds.evidence: Battle of Vanaheim with Thor; secret meeting; Volstagg holds off the Einherjar at the Harrow and Fandral flies the skiff and fights off pursuers.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Darcy catches up with Thor when he finds Jane in London, asking him how space is. After he returns from Svartalfheim, she greets him and Jane at the apartment and joins the fight at Greenwich.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jane's friend, who asks Thor how space is.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friend from New Mexico whom Darcy catches up with in London.
adds.evidence: At the factory Darcy catches up with Thor and asks how space was; back at Jane's apartment she greets them before the group plans for Greenwich.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Heimdall joins Volstagg and Fandral in Thor's secret meeting to get Jane off Asgard, telling them Loki knows the hidden paths, then distracts Odin while they carry out the escape.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow plotters in Thor's escape from Asgard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Gatekeeper who plots with them to get Jane off Asgard.
adds.evidence: Secret meeting of Thor, Heimdall, Sif, Fandral and Volstagg; Heimdall explains other ways off Asgard known to Loki and later distracts Odin.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Heimdall and Sif join Thor's secret plan to get Jane off Asgard. Sif frees Jane while Heimdall distracts Odin by confessing treason.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Warrior who frees Jane while Heimdall distracts Odin.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Gatekeeper who distracts Odin while Sif frees Jane.
adds.evidence: Both attend Thor's secret meeting; Sif frees Foster from her guards; Heimdall summons Odin to Himinbjorg and confesses treason.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

adds.text: Fandral warns Odin that the palace shields are still down after the Dark Elves' attack. Soon after, Fandral and Volstagg defy Odin's orders to help Thor take Jane off Asgard.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Warriors who defy Odin's orders to help Thor.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: King whose orders they defy to help Thor take Jane off Asgard.
adds.evidence: Fandral to Odin: 'We are still unable to restore the palace shields... My king, we are all but defenseless.' They then help Thor's escape against Odin's order that none leave Asgard.
adds.title: Thor: The Dark World

none.title: Thor: The Dark World
none.why: Never share a scene; Selvig only speaks of Loki's hold on his mind and is pleased to hear Loki died.

none.title: Thor: The Dark World
none.why: No exchange between them; Heimdall only names Loki as the one who knows the hidden paths, and Loki is freed and later rules as Odin without dealing with Heimdall.

none.title: Thor: The Dark World
none.why: Steve is not there; Loki only takes his form briefly to mock Thor.

none.title: Thor: The Dark World
none.why: Steve is not there; the Captain America Thor sees is Loki in disguise.
